# Prose

The reading column: styles paragraphs, headings, lists, links, block quotes and rules inside a 66-character line.

```tsx
import { Prose } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For any text longer than a paragraph: articles, blog posts, programme descriptions, contest rules.
- As the container that the other reading components (epigraph, drop cap, pull quote, footnotes) live in.

## When not to

- For interface text such as labels and buttons: those use the UI type and the components themselves.
- With `fullWidth` on long texts: past 75 characters the eye loses its place when it returns to the margin.
- To style content you do not control by overriding it: change the content, or add a token.

## Examples

### A full text

The reading column styles headings, lead, paragraphs, lists, links and rules. It composes with the other reading components.

```tsx
<Prose as="article" aria-label="Ejemplo de texto">
  <Epigraph attribution="Texto de ejemplo">Escribir es aprender a quedarse un rato más en la frase.</Epigraph>
  <h2>La arquitectura del texto</h2>
  <p className={proseLead}>Un buen comienzo no explica: coloca al lector en una habitación y le deja ver qué hay en ella.</p>
  <DropCap>
    Todo texto empieza con una decisión sobre dónde poner la cámara. Quien escribe elige qué se ve primero, qué queda fuera de campo y cuánto tarda la luz en llegar al fondo<Footnote n={1} />.
  </DropCap>
  <p>
    La medida de la línea importa tanto como la frase: entre 45 y 75 caracteres, el ojo vuelve al margen izquierdo sin perderse. Más información en el{' '}
    <a href="#programa">programa del taller</a>.
  </p>
  <PullQuote attribution="Cuaderno de clase">La puntuación es la respiración del texto.</PullQuote>
  <h3>Tres ejercicios</h3>
  <ul>
    <li>Describe una cocina sin nombrar ningún objeto que se use para cocinar.</li>
    <li>Reescribe el primer párrafo quitando todos los adjetivos.</li>
    <li>Cuenta la misma escena desde el objeto más pequeño de la habitación<Footnote n={2} />.</li>
  </ul>
  <hr />
  <Figure src="/portada.svg" alt="Una luna dorada sobre dos colinas oscuras" caption="La luz llega siempre tarde al fondo del cuadro." credit="Ilustración de ejemplo" />
  <Footnotes>
    <FootnoteItem n={1}>La imagen es una licencia de trabajo: sirve para pensar la escena, no para citarla.</FootnoteItem>
    <FootnoteItem n={2}>Es un ejercicio clásico de los talleres de narrativa breve.</FootnoteItem>
  </Footnotes>
</Prose>
```

### Full width

By default a column stops at 66 characters. `fullWidth` lets short texts, such as a card description, fill their container.

```tsx
<Prose fullWidth>
  <p>Un párrafo corto dentro de un contenedor que ya fija su ancho.</p>
</Prose>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as` | `ElementType` |  | Element to render. Use `article` for a full text, `div` inside a layout that already has one. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the text fill its container instead of stopping at the reading measure (66ch). Prefer the default for anything longer than a paragraph. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Measure:** 66 characters by default (`measure.reading`), inside the 45–75 comfort range. `readingStyle()` narrows or widens it to 45 or 75.
- **Contrast:** text is held to 7:1 (WCAG AAA) on page and surface, in both modes.
- **Links** are always underlined (not distinguished by colour alone), with distinct hover and visited colours, all checked for contrast.
- **Headings** keep their native level (`h2`–`h4`); the visual size is separate from the level, so the outline stays correct. `text-wrap: balance` avoids one-word last lines.
- **Zoom and size:** sizes are relative to the reading size preference (`--kafka-reading-scale`), and text reflows up to 400 % zoom.
- Block quotes directly inside the column get the gold rule; `PullQuote` and `Epigraph` are figures and do not.

## Content

- Write one idea per paragraph and let the paragraph break do the work of white space.
- Put the first heading at `h2`; the page title is the `h1`.
- Link text says where the link goes ("programa del taller"), never "aquí".
